result.title: AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training
result.summary: Attention costs $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ in the number of tokens. Vector-quantized attention reduces this to $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ by clustering the $N$ keys, attending to the $M$ codewords instead, and its adaptive form, AVQ-attention, concentrates codebook resolution where a query's attention mass actually falls. We present AVQ-Attention-2, a better design that merges it with exact local attention and attends to the mean of each cluster's keys rather than to a codeword. We show three improvements: consistently better quality at comparable cost; training that now also costs $\mathcal{O}(NM)$ rather than $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$; and an approximation accurate enough that the layer can be dropped into a pretrained transformer without fine-tuning. Across a variety of sequence lengths the result is competitive not merely with other approximate attention but with exact dense attention, running faster than FlashAttention at little to no loss in quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AVQ-Attention-2：将向量量化注意力与精确局部注意力合并，改为对每个簇内键的均值做注意力，并把训练成本从 O(N²) 降至 O(NM)，且可不经微调直接替换预训练 transformer 的注意力层。
AI.relevance_reason: 高效注意力近似或可为长视觉 token 序列与 latent 状态的注意力计算、缓存提供低成本替代，其「局部精确块＋按注意力质量分配码本分辨率」的设计可供核查是否影响视觉细节保留与证据筛选；但原文不涉及多模态推理。
